description: Dreadnaught Pauldrons Level 60 Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreadnaught Pauldrons if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Pauldrons, 12 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 2 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Pauldrons - Wartorn Plate Scrap x 12 - Arcanite Bar x 2 - Cured Rugged Hide x 3
name: Dreadnaught Pauldrons
